description:
AirBoxer is a boxing game you play with your head.

Put in your AirPods. Tilt your head LEFT or RIGHT to slip a hook. NOD DOWN to duck an uppercut. Every slip lands a counter-punch — empty your opponent's bar before they land five on you.

Works with AirPods Pro, AirPods Max, AirPods (3rd generation), AirPods 4 and Beats Fit Pro. There are no touch controls: your head is the controller.


THE OPPONENTS

• SANDBAG — The gym. Slow tells and you can't lose. Learn the rhythm.

• VITRINE BLOOM — Paris. Record 0-99. Telegraphed hooks and a glass jaw. Everyone's first real fight.

• THE WARDEN — Stateville. Record 47-1. Tells near the limit of human reaction. The final knockout.


HOW IT PLAYS

• Real head movement, read from your headphones' motion sensors
• Combo streaks, three dodge zones, knockouts and victory screens
• Original chiptune music and retro arcade look with CRT scanlines
• Built-in How to Play video
• Game Center leaderboards: longest dodge streak and knockouts
• Five motion-sensitivity levels for different necks and play styles
• Pauses automatically when a call comes in


FREE

Every opponent is free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription, no tracking.


PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Head motion is used on your iPhone in real time and thrown away. AirBoxer collects nothing.

Put in your AirPods. Slip the punches. Don't blink.
promotionalText: Put in your AirPods and box with your head: tilt to slip hooks, nod to duck uppercuts, counter to the K.O. Free, no ads.
